# Flower Power Farm Village & Spa — Koh Phayam, Thailand

> An enchanting eco-resort, tropical farm village, and wellness sanctuary located in Buffalo Bay (Ao Khao Kwai) on Koh Phayam, Ranong, Thailand. Featuring 18 private accommodations (luxury villas, handcrafted wooden bungalows, glamping tents, and guesthouse rooms), an outdoor swimming pool, Swedish sauna, ice bath, open-air gym, high-speed WiFi for digital nomads, and an authentic Italian restaurant-pizzeria.

## Quick Facts
- **Location**: Buffalo Bay (Ao Khao Kwai) - 14/32 Moo 1, Koh Phayam, Ranong 85000, Thailand.
- **Resort Concept**: Eco-friendly tropical oasis, permaculture gardens, organic farm, wellness spa, and authentic hospitality on Thailand's unspoiled island paradise.
- **Accommodations Count**: 18 distinct accommodations (Villas, Bungalows, Glamping Tents, Rooms & Lodges).
- **Check-in / Check-out**: Check-in from 09:00 / Check-out until 12:00 (flexible upon boat arrival).
- **Phone & WhatsApp**: +66 95 882 5573 / +66 85 884 4852
- **Official Website & Live Calendar**: [https://www.flowerpowervillage.com](https://www.flowerpowervillage.com)
- **Direct Booking Engine**: [https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/calendar](https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/calendar)
- **Best Price Guarantee**: 10% instant discount on official direct booking compared to OTAs (Booking.com, Agoda, Expedia) with no hidden fees or middlemen commissions.
- **Long Stay Discounts**: Tiered automatic discounts: -10% standard, -15% for 15-29 days, -20% for 30+ days.
- **Pet Friendly**: Yes, pets welcome.

## The 18 Accommodations
### 1. Luxury Villas (Families & Groups)
- **Jungle Villa (Entire Villa)**: 2 connected private suites in the tropical garden, 2 King Size beds, covered veranda, hammocks, direct garden access. Capacity: up to 6 guests. URL: `https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/52-jungle-villa`
- **Jungle Villa Left**: Standalone private suite with King Size bed, private terrace, tropical bathroom, garden view. Capacity: up to 3 guests. URL: `https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/53-jungle-villa-left`
- **Jungle Villa Right**: Standalone private suite with King Size bed, private terrace, tropical bathroom, garden view. Capacity: up to 3 guests. URL: `https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/54-jungle-villa-right`
- **Peace & Love Villa**: Independent family villa nestled in nature with private lounge area, King bed, sofa beds, garden patio. Capacity: up to 4 guests. URL: `https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/51-villa-peace-love`
- **Villa Penthouse**: Premium top-floor panoramic villa overlooking the lush canopy, private expansive outdoor terrace, luxury living area, King bed. Capacity: up to 4 guests. URL: `https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/22-villa-penthouse`

### 2. Handcrafted Wooden Bungalows (Couples & Solo Travelers)
- **Yellow Bungalow**: Charming traditional wooden bungalow with private porch, hammock, Queen bed, surrounded by lush flora. Capacity: 2 guests. URL: `https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/11-yellow-bungalow`
- **Red Bungalow**: Iconic romantic bungalow with Queen bed, private tropical veranda, hammock, en-suite bathroom. Capacity: 2 guests. URL: `https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/12-red-bungalow`
- **Green Bungalow**: Eco-conscious wooden bungalow, private terrace with hammock, Queen bed, tranquil garden setting. Capacity: 2 guests. URL: `https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/13-green-bungalow`

### 3. Glamping Tents (Nature & Comfort)
- **Camel Tent Bungalow**: Spacious safari glamping tent with wooden framing, Queen bed, electrical fan, private wooden deck and outdoor seating. Capacity: 2 guests. URL: `https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/23-camel-tent`
- **Lagoon Tent Bungalow**: Glamping tent positioned by the garden pond with Queen bed, relaxing porch hammock, electrical fan. Capacity: 2 guests. URL: `https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/21-lagoon-tent`

### 4. The Hub Guesthouse (Digital Nomads & Travelers)
- **Rooms 1, 2, 3, 4, 5**: Cozy air-conditioned private rooms with Queen beds, private bathrooms, high-speed WiFi, shared outdoor workspace access. Capacity: 2 guests each. URLs: `/31-room-1` to `/35-room-5`
- **Lodge 1 & Lodge 2**: Large air-conditioned family lodges with King bed + single beds, private bathroom, ideal for small groups. Capacity: up to 4 guests each. URLs: `/36-lodge-1`, `/36-lodge-2`
- **Internal Room**: Budget-friendly private room with Queen bed, shared kitchen access, high-speed WiFi. Capacity: 2 guests. URL: `/41-room-internal`

## Key Resort Amenities & Experiences
- **Outdoor Swimming Pool**: Crystal-clear freshwater pool surrounded by sun loungers and tropical palms.
- **Swedish Sauna & Cold Ice Bath**: Authentic wellness recovery ritual for vitality, muscle relaxation, and health.
- **Open-Air Fitness & Gym**: Shaded open-air workout area equipped with free weights, pull-up bars, and functional training gear.
- **Yoga Space**: Serene open platform amidst tropical birdsong, perfect for daily morning yoga and meditation.
- **High-Speed WiFi & Coworking**: High-speed internet across rooms and common areas, ideal for remote workers and digital nomads.
- **Authentic Italian Restaurant & Traditional Pizzeria**: Freshly made pasta, slow-fermented traditional pizza, artisan Italian cold cuts, salads, and vegetarian options.
- **Curated Wine List**: International wine cellar featuring hand-picked Italian, French, Australian, and Chilean labels.
- **Shared Guest Kitchen**: Fully equipped kitchen for long-term guests in The Hub.

## How to Get to Koh Phayam
1. Fly or take a bus to **Ranong, Thailand**.
2. Head to **Ranong Pier** (Tha Ruea Ranong).
3. Board a **speedboat** to Koh Phayam (runs daily throughout the season, taking 35–45 minutes).
4. Upon arrival at Koh Phayam Pier, Flower Power Village is located in **Buffalo Bay (Ao Khao Kwai)**, about 5–7 minutes by motorbike taxi or rented scooter.
